verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents its own call-AI products: a Conversational Intelligence add-on that uses "AI insights to understand calls" and an Agentic Voice AI platform that "analyze[s] customer interactions end-to-end." That is first-party AI call analysis, but no item explicitly mentions summaries, transcripts, or attaching either to the conversation record. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI call summaries, call transcription, attachment of summaries/transcripts to the call or conversation record, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
